settings.editor: Inspection reports help unsupported solar system owners understand what can be seen, compared and explained. This section is about documenting the system condition, not guessing at hidden faults or making broad promises. For Dallas-Fort Worth owners, that report can support repair planning, property decisions or a second opinion.

Servicing gives future repair decisions better context because it records what the system looked like before larger choices are made. Panel condition, mounting, wiring routes and monitoring history can all affect the next recommendation. This is especially useful when the original solar installer is no longer available to explain the system.
